title: Brill--Noether generality and gonality for chains of cycles and theta graphs
abstract: This repository formalizes Brill--Noether generality for chains whose factors may be cycles or theta graphs, subject to a genericity condition on path lengths and an evenly-marked condition on the theta factors. A graph is called Brill--Noether general if the possible degrees and ranks of its chip configurations, in the sense of Baker and Norine, match the behavior of a general algebraic curve. Here we use only the existential form of Brill--Noether generality, without computing dimensions. Following Cools--Draisma--Payne--Robeva, we also formalize a mild vanishing-order condition that permits the recovery of dimension statements on the algebraic side. A Brill--Noether general graph also has the conjectural maximum gonality in its genus. The chain of cycles case is a theorem of Cools--Draisma--Payne--Robeva, which Pflueger--Solomon generalized to allow evenly-marked theta graphs. Among other things, the construction shows the existence, in every positive genus g, of graphs with every gonality between 2 and ceil(g/2) + 1, inclusive.
